text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for our second race, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching closely all the hard 
work the two of you have put in, so—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I truly believe it's going to be a 
wonderful race!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Seeing them on their big stage... it 
really makes my heart tighten with 
emotion.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Let's give them lots of support, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers supporting <chrname> are roaring. I can't 
afford to lose this race, either!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Let's give them lots of support, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To claim the title of the "strongest," 
next time for sure... I can't afford to 
lose this race!
